observations: Three photos show two black PlayStation controllers resting on a dark, flat, rectangular surface, likely a box or board.
The controllers appear to be standard DualShock 4 models, with the characteristic touchpad, D-pad, and button layout.
The surface they rest on is scratched and worn, suggesting it is not original packaging.
No PlayStation console is visible in any photo.
The seller's text claims a 'very clean and sharp ps4 available with two pads', but the photos only show the two controllers.
Watermark 'JOTHAN GADGET POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.
